[
  {
    "step_type": "condition",
    "description": "Evaluates a template expression against local_state and routes to one of two named steps without performing any I/O. Truthy: non-empty, non-\"null\", non-\"undefined\", non-\"0\". on_truthy and on_falsy are bare step keys (e.g. \"2\", \"3\") — the executor prefixes them to step:N internally. No output_key is written.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "expression", "required": true, "description": "{{template}} expression resolved against local_state — e.g. \"{{input.id}}\"" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_truthy", "required": true, "description": "Bare step key to route to when expression is truthy — e.g. \"2\"" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_falsy", "required": true, "description": "Bare step key to route to when expression is falsy — e.g. \"3\"" }
    ],
    "output_contract": null,
    "on_success_options": [],
    "on_failure_options": []
  },
  {
    "step_type": "end",
    "description": "Terminal step — marks the workflow run as completed. No input or output fields. Every workflow must have exactly one end step as its final step.",
    "input_contract": [],
    "output_contract": null,
    "on_success_options": [],
    "on_failure_options": []
  },
  {
    "step_type": "human_gate",
    "description": "Suspends workflow execution and presents a dialog to the user. Execution resumes when the user clicks an option button. Gate types: confirm (read message, click button), edit_list (review and remove items), text_input (type free text), review_object (review key/value summary). Each option has its own on_select routing token.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "gate_type", "required": true, "description": "confirm | edit_list | text_input | review_object" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "message_template", "required": true, "description": "Message shown to user — supports {{template}} substitution" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "context_key", "required": false, "description": "Dot-path into local_state for the data shown in the dialog (required for edit_list and review_object)" },
      { "type": "array", "field": "options", "required": true, "description": "Array of { label, action, on_select } objects — must include at least one with action: \"cancel\"" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": false, "description": "Only for text_input — the local_state key where the typed value is written on submit" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Default routing when no on_select override applies" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing on gate execution error — not user cancellation" }
    ],
    "output_contract": null,
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "iterator",
    "description": "Executes a single item_step once per element of an array in local_state. Sequential only — one item at a time, one SQS hop per item. Collects results into an array at output_key. Items must be an array written by a prior step.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "items_key", "required": true, "description": "Dot-path into local_state resolving to the array to iterate over" },
      { "type": "object", "field": "item_step", "required": true, "description": "Step definition executed once per item. Use {{item}} or {{item.field}} to reference the current element." },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": false, "description": "local_state key where collected results array is written after all items complete" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_complete", "required": false, "description": "Routing token after all items complete — defaults to \"next\"" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token if an item_step fails" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "array", "field": "output_key", "description": "Array of outputValue from each item_step execution" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "js_transform",
    "description": "Runs a pure synchronous JS expression via acorn AST gate + vm.runInNewContext(200ms). Two bindings available: (1) items — the resolved value of input_key from local_state. (2) local_state — the full workflow state object; use local_state.key_name to read any prior step output across steps. No async, no I/O, no Node globals. Expression must be an IIFE or value expression that returns the output. Use for score tallies, filters, aggregations, string formatting, loop state mutations.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "expression", "required": true, "description": "Synchronous JS IIFE or value expression. items = resolved input_key value. local_state = full workflow state. Must return the output value. Example: (function(){ return items.filter(r => r.score > 0).length; })()" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "input_key", "required": true, "description": "Dot-path into local_state resolving to the input value bound as 'items'. Required." },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "Dot-path where the result is written to local_state" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token — supports step:N for backward loops" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "any", "field": "output_key", "description": "Result of the expression written to local_state[output_key]" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "llm_call",
    "description": "Calls an LLM using a named prompt from PGC_Prompt. Resolves template variables from local_state into the prompt. Runs the 2-attempt validation/correction loop. Writes the validated output object to output_key.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.prompt", "required": true, "description": "intent_category key into PGC_Prompt — identifies which prompt to use" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "local_state key where the validated LLM output object is written" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token — defaults to \"next\"" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token — use \"human_feedback\" for recoverable failures" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "The validated LLM output object written to local_state[output_key]" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "notify",
    "description": "Sends a message to the user via the callback channel (Slack or any UI). The message_template is resolved against local_state. Does not block — fire and forget. Typically the second-to-last step before \"end\".",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "message_template", "required": true, "description": "Message text — supports {{template}} substitution from local_state" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "notify_type", "required": false, "description": "SQS message type — defaults to WORKFLOW_NOTIFY" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token — typically \"end\" on the final notify step" }
    ],
    "output_contract": null,
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end"],
    "on_failure_options": []
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_delete",
    "description": "Deletes rows from a PGC or PGD table matching the given filters. Filters must be non-empty — unfiltered mass deletes are rejected.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.tableName", "required": true, "description": "Table name — must be registered in PGC_TableMap with allow_delete: true" },
      { "type": "array", "field": "input.filters", "required": true, "description": "Non-empty filter array" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "{ tableName, deletedCount }" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_entity_get",
    "description": "Fetches one assembled entity by id via SERV-Entity getEntity. Returns root columns plus child arrays.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.entityName", "required": true, "description": "Entity name matching PGC_EntitySchema.entity_name" },
      { "type": "integer", "field": "input.id", "required": true, "description": "Primary key id" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "Assembled entity object — root columns plus child arrays" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_entity_query",
    "description": "Lists assembled entities via SERV-Entity listEntities. Returns root columns plus jsonb_agg child arrays.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.entityName", "required": true, "description": "Entity name matching PGC_EntitySchema.entity_name" },
      { "type": "array", "field": "input.filters", "required": false, "description": "Filter array applied to root table" },
      { "type": "integer", "field": "input.limit", "required": false, "description": "Maximum number of entities to return" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "array", "field": "output_key", "description": "Array of assembled entity objects" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_entity_schema",
    "description": "Loads a full entity schema by reading PGC_EntitySchema for join topology and PGC_Schema for live column definitions. Returns entity_name, root { table, columns }, and children.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.entityName", "required": true, "description": "Entity name matching PGC_EntitySchema.entity_name" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "{ entity_name, description, root: { table, columns: [{name,type}] }, children: [...] }" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_insert",
    "description": "Inserts a single row into any PGC or PGD table. Returns the inserted row including generated id.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.tableName", "required": true, "description": "Table name — must be registered in PGC_TableMap" },
      { "type": "object", "field": "input.row", "required": true, "description": "Row object — system columns auto-populated" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": false, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "The inserted row including populated id" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_query",
    "description": "Reads rows from a PGC or PGD table with optional filters, ordering, and limit. Empty result is not an error — returns an empty array.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.tableName", "required": true, "description": "Table name" },
      { "type": "array", "field": "input.filters", "required": false, "description": "Filter array. Ops: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in, is_null, not_null" },
      { "type": "object", "field": "input.orderBy", "required": false, "description": "{ column, direction }" },
      { "type": "integer", "field": "input.limit", "required": false, "description": "Maximum rows" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "array", "field": "output_key", "description": "Array of row objects" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_schema",
    "description": "Creates a physical PostgreSQL table via SERV-Schema createTable. Registers in PGC_Schema and PGC_TableMap. Used inside iterators driven by a tables array.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "object", "field": "input", "required": true, "description": "Full table definition — tableName, target, columns, foreignKeys, constraints, triggers. May be \"{{item}}\" inside an iterator." },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "{ tableName, status: \"created\" }" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "serv_update",
    "description": "Updates rows in a PGC or PGD table matching the given filters. Filters must be non-empty.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.tableName", "required": true, "description": "Table name" },
      { "type": "array", "field": "input.filters", "required": true, "description": "Non-empty filter array" },
      { "type": "object", "field": "input.updates", "required": true, "description": "column → new value pairs" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": false, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "{ tableName, updatedCount, rows }" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  },
  {
    "step_type": "simulate",
    "description": "Dry-runs a workflow step array through three validation levels without calling real services. Level 1: static analysis. Level 2: path execution using mock_outputs and simulation_paths. Level 3: skip-path analysis.",
    "input_contract": [
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.steps_key", "required": true, "description": "Dot-path to the steps array" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.mock_outputs_key", "required": false, "description": "Dot-path to mock_outputs — required for Level 2" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "input.paths_key", "required": false, "description": "Dot-path to simulation_paths — required for Level 2" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "output_key", "required": true, "description": "local_state key" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_success", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" },
      { "type": "string", "field": "on_failure", "required": false, "description": "Routing token" }
    ],
    "output_contract": [{ "type": "object", "field": "output_key", "description": "{ passed, paths_run, paths_passed, paths_failed, static_analysis, path_results }" }],
    "on_success_options": ["next", "end", "step:N"],
    "on_failure_options": ["human_feedback", "cancel", "step:N"]
  }
]

ROUTING VALUE RULES — every on_success, on_failure, and on_select field in a workflow step must use one of these exact tokens:

  next            — advance to the sequentially next step in the array
  end             — terminate the workflow run as completed
  cancel          — cancel the run and clear the stack (same effect as the user clicking Cancel)
  human_feedback  — when a step fails, pause execution and show the user a Retry/Skip/Cancel recovery gate
  step:<key>      — jump directly to the step with the given key (e.g. "step:3", "step:3a")

NOTES:
- "step:N" uses the actual step key string, not a position index. "step:3a" jumps to the step whose "step" field is "3a".
- Backward references (routing to an earlier step key) are safe ONLY when there is at least one human_gate on the path from the target back to the source. Without a gate, backward references create infinite loops.
- on_failure should be "human_feedback" for any step that calls an external service (llm_call, serv_query, serv_insert, serv_update, serv_delete). Use "cancel" only for non-recoverable logical failures.
- Every human_gate MUST have at least one option with action: "cancel". This is enforced by the static analysis validator.
- notify steps only support "next" and "end" in on_success — they have no on_failure.
- end steps have no routing fields.

WORKED EXAMPLE — create_domain workflow (condensed data flow)

This is the canonical example of a correct workflow definition. Use it as the reference for step structure, template syntax, data flow, and the expression-based js_transform pattern.

run.input = { userInput: "stock portfolio" }

Step 1  llm_call (prompt: "create_domain", user_input: "{{input.userInput}}")
        → output_key: "proposed_scaffold"
        → local_state.proposed_scaffold = { domain: "stock_portfolio", tables: [...] }
        → on_success: "next", on_failure: "human_feedback"

Step 2  js_transform (expression-based, input_key: "proposed_scaffold.tables", output_key: "proposed_scaffold.tables")
        expression: "(function() { var SYS = new Set(['id','created_at','updated_at']); return items.map(function(t) { var cols = t.columns.filter(function(c){ return !SYS.has(c.name); }).slice(0,4).map(function(c){ return c.name; }); return Object.assign({}, t, { columnSummary: cols.join(', '), domain: local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain }); }); })()"
        → enriches each table with columnSummary field
        → NOTE: local_state is a first-class sandbox binding — use local_state.key_name to read any prior step output
        → NOTE: transform_type built-ins (columnSummary, buildChildInserts, etc.) are REMOVED — always use expression
        → on_success: "next"

Step 3  human_gate (gate_type: "edit_list", context_key: "proposed_scaffold.tables")
        → options: [confirm→"step:3d", add_table→"step:3a", cancel→"cancel"]
        → on_success: "next", on_failure: "cancel"

Step 3a human_gate (gate_type: "text_input", output_key: "new_table_description")
        → user types table description, written to local_state.new_table_description
        → on_success: "next", on_failure: "cancel"

Step 3b llm_call (prompt: "design_table", inputs: domain, existing_tables, user_input)
        → output_key: "new_table"

Step 3c js_transform (expression merges new_table into proposed_scaffold.tables)
        → reads local_state.new_table and local_state.proposed_scaffold via local_state binding
        → on_success: "step:3"  ← intentional backward reference (safe — step 3 is a human_gate)

Step 3d human_gate (gate_type: "review_object", context_key: "proposed_scaffold.tables")
        → confirm → "next", cancel → "cancel"

Step 4  human_gate (gate_type: "confirm") — final DDL confirmation
        → confirm → "next", cancel → "cancel"

Step 5  iterator (items_key: "proposed_scaffold.tables", execution_mode: "sequential")
          item_step: serv_schema createTable({{item}})
        → output_key: "created_tables", on_complete: "next"

Step 6  js_transform (expression derives registration data from scaffold — no LLM)
        → reads: local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain, local_state.proposed_scaffold.tables
        → output_key: "generated" = { domainHelp, intentMapRows, entitySchemas }

Step 7  human_gate (gate_type: "review_object", context_key: "generated.domainHelp")
        → confirm → "next", cancel → "cancel"

Step 8  serv_insert (tableName: "PGC_DomainHelp", row: "{{generated.domainHelp}}")

Step 9  iterator over generated.intentMapRows — serv_insert PGC_IntentMap({{item}})

Step 10b iterator over generated.entitySchemas — serv_insert PGC_EntitySchema({{item}})

Step 11 notify "Domain {{proposed_scaffold.domain}} created."
        → on_success: "end"

Step 12 end

KEY PATTERNS FROM THIS EXAMPLE:
- Template syntax: {{key}}, {{key.field}}, {{key.0.field}}, {{item}}, {{item.field}}, {{input.field}}
- output_key establishes the local_state key that downstream steps reference
- js_transform ALWAYS uses expression — never transform_type (built-ins are removed)
- expression is an IIFE: (function(){ ... return value; })()
- local_state is available in every expression — read any prior step output via local_state.key_name
- Backward references (step:3) are safe only when every path back passes through at least one human_gate
- serv_insert row values use template substitution: "{{generated.domainHelp}}" resolves to the full object
- iterator must always include execution_mode: "sequential"

FLAT LOOP PATTERN — for workflows that iterate over a collection with human interaction per item:

Use this when a simple iterator cannot be used because each item requires human interaction (e.g. a quiz, a review flow, a step-by-step tutorial).

Example: Spanish vocabulary quiz
  state: local_state.cards (array loaded once), local_state.index (0), local_state.score ({ passed:0, failed:0 })

  Step 1: serv_entity_query — load flashcards into local_state.cards (with optional set_id filter)
  Step 2: js_transform — shuffle cards, initialise index=0 and score={passed:0,failed:0} using (function(){ return { cards: shuffle(items), index: 0, score: {passed:0,failed:0} }; })()
          output_key: "quiz_state"
  Step 3: js_transform — pick current card: (function(){ return local_state.quiz_state.cards[local_state.quiz_state.index]; })()
          input_key: "quiz_state", output_key: "current_card"
  Step 4: human_gate confirm — show card front (message_template: "Term: {{current_card.term}}"), options: [Show answer→next, Cancel→cancel]
  Step 5: human_gate text_input — show card back, user types answer, output_key: "user_answer"
  Step 6: llm_call evaluate_translation — input: { term: "{{current_card.term}}", definition: "{{current_card.definition}}", user_answer: "{{user_answer}}" }, output_key: "eval_result"
  Step 7: js_transform — update score and advance index:
          expression: (function(){ var qs = local_state.quiz_state; var res = local_state.eval_result; var newScore = { passed: qs.score.passed + (res.result==='pass'?1:0), failed: qs.score.failed + (res.result==='fail'?1:0) }; return { cards: qs.cards, index: qs.index + 1, score: newScore }; })()
          input_key: "quiz_state", output_key: "quiz_state"
  Step 8: human_gate confirm — show result + feedback (message_template: "{{eval_result.feedback}}"), options: [Next card→step:3, Finish→step:9, Cancel→cancel]
          ← BACKWARD REFERENCE: step:3 is safe because steps 4, 5, 8 are human_gates in the loop path
  Step 9: condition — check if more cards remain: expression: "{{quiz_state.index}}"
          Actually use a js_transform before: compute done = index >= cards.length, then condition on that flag
  Step 10: notify — quiz summary
  Step 11: end

FLAT LOOP GUARD 3 SAFETY RULE:
- A backward reference (e.g. step 8 → step:3) is SAFE if and only if the path from the target step back to the source step contains at least one human_gate
- Without a human_gate in the loop, the Step Processor spins synchronously and exhausts Lambda
- Always verify: target_step ... [human_gate] ... source_step ... backward_ref → target_step
